**Plants sit on layers, and annotation layers have names**

Conquest Reforged's plants now sit on the layers under them wherever they grow: on the layers Smooth terrain lays, on a cover of layer blocks, or on a terrain whose top is a block of layers, each plant is written with the eighths of the block under it, with nothing to set up (no plant layers exported first or materials file as in WorldPainter). The game's plants, which cannot sit lower, keep a whole block under them rather than floating. Annotations can be layers of their own, as WorldPainter's custom annotation layers: + beside Annotations in the Layers panel makes one with its name and colour, listed there to paint with, rename, recolour and show or hide on its own; a WorldPainter world brings its custom annotation layers in as such, by name.
